stockReconciliation.gagalBeruntun: Failed {n} times in a row since {sejak}. Same cause each time:

noop.alreadyPaid: This PO was already marked paid — nothing changed and no journal was posted. If the earlier mark's payment journal never posted, unmark payment and mark it paid again.
noop.alreadyUnpaid: This PO was already marked unpaid — nothing changed and no journal was posted. If its reversal journal never posted, this PO shows a standing-payment warning with a button that posts the reversal.

standingPayment.title: A payment journal is standing for a PO that is not marked paid
standingPayment.body: This PO's paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal failed to post, so the payment journal still stands on the ledger: payables are cleared and bank is credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. Marking it paid again does not fix that — post the reversal from here.
standingPayment.needsPermission: Posting this reversal needs the journals:manage permission. Ask a Finance user to do it from this PO's page.
standingPayment.markBlocked: "Mark as paid" is disabled while this payment journal is still standing — marking it paid again only hides the warning above without fixing the ledger. Post the reversal journal from that warning first, then mark it paid.
standingPayment.markBlockedRegister: "Mark paid" is disabled: a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing on the ledger even though this PO reads unpaid. Open this PO's detail page, post the reversal journal from the warning there, then mark it paid again.
standingPayment.markRefused: The paid mark was not saved: a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing on the ledger even though this PO reads unpaid. Nothing was written — the payment status, the journals and this PO's history are all unchanged. Post the reversal journal from the standing-payment warning on this page first, then mark it paid again.
standingPayment.markRefusedRegister: The paid mark was not saved: a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing on the ledger even though this PO reads unpaid. Nothing was written — the payment status, the journals and this PO's history are all unchanged. Open this PO's detail page, post the reversal journal from the warning there, then mark it paid again.
standingPayment.posted: Reversal journal posted. The ledger now matches this PO's unpaid status.
standingPayment.errForbidden: You do not have the journals:manage permission needed to post this reversal.
standingPayment.errBadState: This PO is no longer in that state — either the reversal has been posted or the PO was marked paid again. The page has been reloaded.
standingPayment.errFailed: The reversal journal could not be posted ({code}). Check the account mapping and this PO's journals in Finance, then try again.

err.GRN_APPROVAL_PENDING: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. One of this PO's receipts is still awaiting the owner's decision. Have the owner approve or decline it first, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.GRN_JOURNALS_INCOMPLETE: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. One of this PO's receipts has no GRN journal. Post the missing GRN journal from its GRN row, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.GRN_REVERSAL_MISSING: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. A receipt was declined by the owner and its GRN journal was never reversed. Post the reversal journal from the declined GRN's row, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.AP_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. The receipts booked their payable to a different account than the AP posting role now resolves to. Check the AP account mapping in Account Mapping, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.PAYMENT_SUPERSEDED: The payment status was saved, but a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing for a different amount than this PO now owes, so no new journal was posted. Payables and bank are NOT untouched here — they still hold that earlier payment, which no longer clears this PO's payable. Unmark payment, confirm in Finance that the reversal journal actually posted this time, then mark it paid again. If that reversal fails too, this PO raises a standing-payment warning with a button that posts the reversal directly.
err.UNMAPPED_ROLE: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. The posting role "{role}" is not mapped to an account. Map it in Account Mapping, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.NOTHING_TO_POST: The PO was marked paid, but no payable was found booked to the GL for it, so no journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. Confirm this PO should be marked paid at all; if a receipt is missing, receive it first, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.

UNBALANCED.payment: The payment status was saved, but the payment journal was unbalanced (debit ≠ credit) so it was not posted — payables and bank are both untouched. Check this PO's journals in Finance, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
UNBALANCED.reversal: The paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal was unbalanced (debit ≠ credit) so it was not posted. Payables and bank are NOT untouched here — the earlier payment journal is still standing, so payables are cleared and bank is credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. This PO shows a standing-payment warning; post the reversal from the button on that warning.

GENERIC.payment: The payment status was saved, but the payment journal failed to post because of an unexpected error. Check this PO's journals and the account mapping in Finance; if the payment journal really is missing, unmark payment and mark it paid again.
GENERIC.reversal: The paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal failed to post because of an unexpected error, so the earlier payment journal is most likely still standing — payables cleared and bank credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. Check this PO's journals in Finance; if the standing-payment warning is shown on this PO, post the reversal from the button on it.

hpp.helpIntro: HPP (cost of goods manufactured) adds up fabric, accessories, and service cost per piece as recorded: some costs already include VAT and some do not (see the VAT status column and the "Price includes VAT" column in the breakdown). Selling price = HPP × (1 + markup%) + additional cost. Markup is taken on HPP, not on the selling price.
hpp.helpWhenStored: When production receives finished goods (via Work Order receipt), the system stores on each receipt:
hpp.helpMaterialCost: Material cost — total cost of materials issued for that production
hpp.helpAvgCostPerUnit: Avg cost per unit — total cost (e.g. material + CMT if applicable) divided by quantity received
hpp.helpTableExplanation: The table shows for each work order: its status, cost layers, HPP per piece, VAT status (Mixed when some costs include VAT and some do not), markup, and selling price. The HPP/pcs in the table and in the breakdown is the same figure. The breakdown also gives the HPP if every cost included VAT: costs without VAT are raised by the VAT rate. Cancelled work orders are hidden unless chosen in the status filter.
hpp.helpFuture: Labor/CMT and overhead can be included in future updates via WO or allocation rules.

ANALOGOUS.name: Analogous
ANALOGOUS.hint: Neighbours on the wheel. Calm and cohesive — safe for a feed that should feel like one mood.

MONOCHROMATIC.name: Monochromatic
MONOCHROMATIC.hint: One hue at several strengths and brightnesses. Clean and elegant, but text needs a clear light–dark difference.

TRIAD.name: Triad
TRIAD.hint: Three hues evenly spaced on the wheel. Lively and balanced — let one colour lead.

COMPLEMENTARY.name: Complementary
COMPLEMENTARY.hint: A colour and its opposite across the wheel. The loudest pairing — good for calls to action and promo price tags.

SPLIT_COMPLEMENTARY.name: Split Complementary
SPLIT_COMPLEMENTARY.hint: The base plus the two neighbours of its opposite. Still contrasting, softer than complementary.

SQUARE.name: Square
SQUARE.hint: Four hues a quarter-turn apart. The busiest — suits colourful campaigns.

COMPOUND.name: Compound
COMPOUND.hint: Neighbours mixed with opposites. Rich, but still under control.

SHADES.name: Shades
SHADES.hint: Exactly the same colour at different brightness. The safest for layered backgrounds.

CUSTOM.name: Custom
CUSTOM.hint: Each colour moves on its own. Editing any colour other than the base switches here automatically.

AAA.name: AAA
AAA.hint: 7 and up — comfortable for long text

AA.name: AA
AA.hint: 4.5 and up — fine for normal text

desc.INVENTORY: Raw-material inventory (fabric, accessories): debited when received from a supplier, credited when used in production or reduced by an opname.
desc.INVENTORY_FG: Finished-goods inventory: debited when a work order's output is received or finished goods are bought, credited when sold (COGS), loaded onto a van, sent as a KOL sample, or reduced by an opname.
desc.INVENTORY_VAN: Stock currently loaded on a canvasser's van; debited when the van is loaded, credited when sold or returned.
desc.AP: Liability account for amounts owed to suppliers.
desc.AR: Asset account for amounts owed by customers/marketplaces.
desc.SALES_REVENUE: Revenue account credited when a sale is recorded.
desc.COGS: Expense account for the cost of goods sold.
desc.BANK: Bank account for payment receipts and disbursements via transfer/settlement. For physical cash, use the Cash role instead.
desc.CASH: Physical cash account — debited when a canvassing sale is paid in cash in the field.
desc.MARKETPLACE_FEE: Expense account for marketplace platform fee deductions.
desc.MARKETPLACE_FEE_ADMIN: Expense for the admin fee deducted by the marketplace, from the Biaya Administrasi column.
desc.MARKETPLACE_FEE_SERVICE: Expense for the service fee deducted by the marketplace, from the Biaya Layanan column.
desc.MARKETPLACE_FEE_COMMISSION: Expense for the commission deducted by the marketplace, from the Biaya Komisi AMS column.
desc.MARKETPLACE_FEE_PROCESSING: Expense for the order processing fee, from the Biaya Proses Pesanan column.
desc.MARKETPLACE_FEE_OTHER: Unitemized remainder of marketplace deductions — including ad fees, shipping subsidies, adjustments, and every TikTok fee.
desc.INVENTORY_VARIANCE: Account for recording stock opname/reconciliation variances.
desc.KOL_EXPENSE: Expense for KOL fees (recognised when the content goes live) and samples sent to KOLs.
desc.KOL_PAYABLE: KOL fees already recognised as expense but not yet paid.
desc.KOL_PREPAID: KOL fee instalments paid before the content goes live; moved to KOL Payable when the fee is recognised.
desc.PPH21_PAYABLE: Non-employee PPh 21 withheld from individual KOL fees, until deposited.
desc.PPH23_PAYABLE: PPh 23 withheld from fees of KOL companies (agencies, PT, CV), until deposited.
desc.AR_STORE: Receivables from outright-purchase (putus) stores: debited when a billing note is issued (delivery), credited when a payment report is verified, a return is recognised, or a deduction is approved.
desc.AR_CONSIGNMENT: Amounts owed by consignment stores for goods sold in the store: debited when a consignment cycle is locked, credited when the store's payment is recorded.
desc.INVENTORY_CONSIGNMENT: Elorae-owned goods held at consignment stores: debited when goods are sent to the store, credited when sold (COGS) or returned to the warehouse.
desc.INVENTORY_DAMAGED: Damaged or expired goods in the damaged-goods warehouse: debited when a damaged return is received, credited when repaired, sold off, or destroyed.
desc.SALES_RETURN: Contra-revenue account (Revenue type, debit balance) for the value of recognised returns, so the income statement shows net sales.
desc.SALES_DISCOUNT: Contra-revenue account for discounts given to stores or buyers (non-return payment deductions, promotions borne by Elorae).
desc.PPN_MASUKAN: Creditable VAT paid to suppliers (only when Elorae is a VAT-registered PKP): debited when goods or services are received, credited when the VAT period is settled.
desc.PPN_KELUARAN: VAT charged on sales (only when Elorae is a PKP): credited when a sale is recognised, debited on returns or when the VAT period is settled.
desc.PPN_PAYABLE: Output VAT minus input VAT for a period that must be paid: credited when the period is settled, debited when paid (NTPN).
desc.PPH4_2_PAYABLE: Final PPh Article 4(2) withheld from rent payments (10%), until deposited.
desc.PPH_FINAL_PAYABLE: Final SME income tax of 0.5% of monthly gross turnover, until paid (only when the final-tax regime applies).
desc.PPH_FINAL_EXPENSE: Expense for the 0.5% final SME income tax on monthly turnover.
desc.PPH22_PREPAID: PPh 22 of 0.5% collected by marketplaces on sales (from 1 Oct 2026): a tax credit when Elorae is not on the final-tax regime.
desc.PPH23_PREPAID: PPh 23 withheld by VAT-registered stores when paying their bills (tax-type payment deductions); a tax credit until its withholding slip is credited.
desc.PPH25_PREPAID: PPh 25 instalments already paid; reduces the corporate income tax due at year end.
desc.SPG_COMMISSION_EXPENSE: SPG pay and commission, recognised when the commission is set or the consignment figures are locked.
desc.SALES_COMMISSION_EXPENSE: Field salesperson commission, recognised when it is set.
desc.COMMISSION_PAYABLE: SPG and salesperson commission or pay already set but not yet paid; reduced by lost-goods deductions and payments.
desc.LOSS_EXPENSE: Cost of goods lost (the share borne by Elorae) or destroyed.
desc.LOSS_RECOVERY: Recovery of lost goods charged to a store, SPG or salesperson (through a bill or a commission deduction).
desc.REIMBURSE_PAYABLE: Approved travel expenses not yet paid back to the employee.
desc.FIXED_ASSET: Acquisition cost of fixed assets (vehicles, machines, equipment, buildings).
desc.ACCUM_DEPRECIATION: Contra fixed-asset account (Asset type, credit balance): credited by each monthly depreciation, debited when the asset is disposed of.
desc.DEPRECIATION_EXPENSE: Monthly depreciation expense of fixed assets.
desc.ASSET_DISPOSAL_GAIN_LOSS: Difference between the proceeds of a fixed asset and its book value (a Revenue or an Expense account).
desc.RETAINED_EARNINGS: Equity account that receives the profit or loss of a closed year through the year-end closing journal.
desc.OPENING_EQUITY: Offset for opening-balance journals on the ledger start date (cash, inventory, receivables, payables, existing assets).
desc.BANK_CHARGES: Bank administration and transfer fees, e.g. from bank statement lines.
desc.OTHER_INCOME: Income outside sales, e.g. bank interest.
desc.PREPAID_EXPENSE: Expenses paid for future periods (rent, subscriptions), expensed over time.
desc.ACCRUED_EXPENSE: Expenses incurred but not yet billed or paid; offset of accrual journals reversed at the start of the next month.

receivables.pageDescription: Unpaid store billing. A receivable only drops once finance matches the payment claim against the bank statement.
receivables.emptyBody: A receivable appears on its own once a billing note is issued from a putus delivery, or can be brought in by Excel import for sales made outside Elorae.
receivables.reasonKlaim: You reported a transfer via {no}. Finance has not seen the money land yet, so it does not count as settled.
receivables.reasonTertahan: Held by return {nilai} — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received. The balance cannot reach zero until the shortfall is settled.
receivables.reasonLewat: The shop promised {tgl} — {hari} days past and no money has arrived. Chase it and get a new date.
receivables.reasonTt: Handed over ({no}). The shop promised {tgl} — wait for the date.
receivables.reasonBelum: Not yet due and not on a collection note — no return hanging.
receivables.reasonJatuhTempo: Due {tgl} — {hari} days past and not on a collection note. Chase the store or make a collection note.
receivables.reasonKlaimKantor: Reported by {pelapor} via {no}. Not counted as settled until finance sees the money in the bank.

payments.pageDescription: Transfer claims reported by sales. A receivable only drops once finance matches it against the bank statement.
payments.rejectBody: Sales reads the reason on their phone. Say what is wrong and what they should do — without it they will chase the same place again.
payments.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. money has not landed as of today, ask the shop to resend the transfer proof
payments.emptyBody: Claims appear here once sales reports from the field that a shop has transferred.
payments.okVerified: Claim verified — the receivable has been recomputed.
payments.okRejected: Claim rejected. Sales will see the reason.
payments.errTANPA_AKSES: Only finance may decide a claim.
payments.errTIDAK_DITEMUKAN: Claim not found — it may have been deleted.
payments.errSUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: This claim was already decided. Reload the page.
payments.errGAGAL: Could not save the decision. Try again.
payments.newBody: A report that the shop has transferred. This does NOT reduce the receivable — finance matches it against the bank statement.
payments.sectionInvoicesHint: Tick the invoices, then enter how much if it is not the full amount.
payments.sectionDeductionsHint: A deduction that comes from a return must be linked to its return note — that link is what holds the amount until the warehouse finishes counting.
payments.proofHint: Match the figure in the transfer photo against the bank statement before verifying.
payments.noOpenInvoices: This shop has no open invoices.
payments.deductionReturnHint: A deduction linked to a return note is held in full until the warehouse counts, then only the shortfall is held until somebody bears it.
payments.transferPhotoHint: Required. This is what finance matches against the bank statement.
payments.breakdownPhotoHint: Optional. The shop's own working sheet, if there is one.
payments.negativeReceived: Deductions exceed the invoice value. Check the figures.
payments.claimNotSettled: Until this is verified, the receivable does not drop by a single rupiah.
payments.heldExplain: Verified, but {value} is not recognised — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received.
payments.okClaimCreated: {doc} sent. Waiting for finance to verify.
payments.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The transfer date could not be read.
payments.errTANPA_PIUTANG: Pick the invoices being settled first.
payments.errPIUTANG_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: One of the invoices no longer exists. Reload this page.
payments.errBEDA_TOKO: One claim covers one shop only.
payments.errSUDAH_LUNAS: One of the invoices turns out to be settled. Reload this page.
payments.errMELEBIHI_SISA: One invoice is being settled for more than it has outstanding.
payments.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: One of the figures is not valid.
payments.errRETUR_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The chosen return note no longer exists.
payments.errRETUR_BEDA_TOKO: That return note belongs to a different shop.
payments.errFOTO_WAJIB: The transfer receipt photo is required.
payments.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The claim number clashed. Try sending again.
payments.errJENIS_BUTUH_RETUR: A deduction of this type must be linked to a return note.
payments.errJENIS_HANYA_PKP: This deduction is for PKP stores only. Mark the store as PKP first if that is correct.
payments.errJENIS_BUTUH_CATATAN: A deduction of this type must have an explanation.
payments.voidBody: For a claim that was ENTERED WRONG — wrong invoice, wrong amount, wrong return link. Different from rejecting, which means the money genuinely was not in the account. The row is kept, and the receivable is recomputed.
payments.voidPlaceholder: e.g. wrong invoice picked, re-entered on another claim
payments.why_DIBATALKAN: This report was voided because it was entered wrong, not because the money was missing.
payments.relinkBody: Change which return note the deduction “{nama}” points at, or unlink it. This changes how much is held, so the receivable is recomputed.
payments.danglingRow: the return note it points at no longer exists
payments.danglingWarning: A deduction points at a return note that no longer exists. Its value is held in full against the receivable — the safe direction — but it will never be released until the link is corrected with “Re-link”.
payments.okClaimQueued: Saved on the phone. The report sends by itself once there is a signal.
payments.errKUNCI_DIPAKAI: This report clashes with another salesperson's. Make a new report.
payments.photoHint_transfer: Required. This is what finance matches against the bank statement.
payments.photoHint_tunai: Required. The receipt signed and stamped by the store, as proof the cash was handed over.
payments.photoHint_giro: Required. A photo of the slip itself, with its number and dates readable.
payments.sectionGiroHint: A giro is not money yet. The receivable only drops once the giro clears into the account.
payments.giroEffectiveHint: No later than {date} — a giro slip is valid for 70 days from its issue date.
payments.claimNotSettledGiro: A giro is not money yet: the receivable does not drop at all until the giro clears into the account.
payments.errGIRO_TANGGAL_WAJIB: Enter both the issue date and the effective date.
payments.errGIRO_EFEKTIF_SEBELUM_TERBIT: The effective date cannot be before the issue date.
payments.errGIRO_LEWAT_MASA_BERLAKU: The effective date is past the giro validity period: at most 70 days from the issue date (Bank Indonesia regulation PBI 18/41/PBI/2016). The bank would refuse this giro.
payments.errGIRO_BELUM_CAIR: This giro has not cleared yet. Mark it cleared from the giro list once the money is in the account.
payments.errBUKAN_GIRO_MENUNGGU: This giro was already decided. Reload the page.
payments.needDeduction: Fill in the name and amount of every deduction.
payments.needPhoto: Fill in the "{label}" box — the photo is required.
payments.salinan: Copied from {doc}. The date, payment method and photos (if any) are filled in — choose the right store, then tick its invoices.
payments.errPENGGANTI_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The payment report to replace was not found.
payments.errPENGGANTI_MASIH_BERLAKU: The old payment report is still active. Withdraw or cancel it before reporting again.
payments.errPENGGANTI_BUKAN_MILIK: The old payment report is not yours.
payments.errSUDAH_DIGANTI: The old payment report already has a replacement — the same money cannot be reported twice.
payments.errTOKO_TIDAK_DIIZINKAN: These invoices are not yours to collect — the store is held by another salesperson. Ask the office to assign the collection to you.
payments.errPEMERIKSA_SAMA: You reported or recorded this payment receipt, so you cannot decide it yourself. Ask another finance admin to review it.
payments.errRETUR_TERPAKAI: That return note's deduction is more than can still be deducted: it is already used on another receipt, or its shortfall was assigned to the store so only the goods that arrived may be deducted. Pick another note or reduce the deduction to the remaining amount shown.
payments.errFOTO_BUKAN_MILIK: This proof photo was uploaded by someone else. Take your own photo of the proof.
payments.errVerifikasiMELEBIHI_SISA: Since this payment receipt was reported, its invoice has been settled by another receipt, so what is left is now less than this receipt's amount. Reject this receipt or ask the salesperson to correct the amount.
payments.pemeriksaSamaSingkat: Your own receipt — another finance admin decides it.
payments.emptyFilteredTitle: No payment claims match this filter
payments.errFOTO_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: This proof photo is identical to someone else's photo already used on another report. Take your own proof photo.
payments.errRETUR_DITAHAN: Part of this invoice's balance is still held by a return deduction on another verified receipt. That part is released by itself once the return is settled, so it must not be paid twice — lower the payment to the part that is not held.
payments.alreadyReportedBody: This invoice is already in {bkm}, which is still awaiting verification. Report it again only if this is a different payment.

storeReturns.pageDescription: One list for every return. Each row names the next step and whose turn it is.
storeReturns.summary: {count} to work on · {held} held back from receivables
storeReturns.flow1Body: Number and contents copied from the shop's own note. The number is theirs, not ours.
storeReturns.flow2Body: Counts what actually arrived. Until it is counted, the return deduction is not recognised at all.
storeReturns.flow3Body: If less arrived than the shop claimed, decide who bears it. Until then the invoice stays open.
storeReturns.effectKeputusan: the difference holds the invoice open
storeReturns.effectCek: the return deduction is not recognised
storeReturns.effectJodoh: goods arrived with no shop note
storeReturns.whyKeputusan: The warehouse received less than the shop claimed. That difference holds the invoice open until somebody is named to bear it.
storeReturns.whyCek: The goods are not recorded as received. While that is empty, the return deduction on the payment claim counts for nothing.
storeReturns.whyJodoh: Goods arrived with no shop note. They must be matched to one before anything can be compared.
storeReturns.whyBeres: Claim and physical agree, or the difference has been assigned.
storeReturns.whyBatal: The note was withdrawn. Deductions already pointing at it stay held in full.
storeReturns.noNrtHint: Copy it exactly from the shop's note. This is the number you will look for in the archive.
storeReturns.createBody: What the shop says it returned. Until the warehouse counts, the whole amount is held back from the receivable — a return is recognised at the physical amount, not the claimed one.
storeReturns.countBody: {doc} — the shop claims {claimed}. Enter the value of what actually arrived.
storeReturns.receiveOrphanTitle: Receive goods with no shop note
storeReturns.receiveOrphanBody: The goods arrived ahead of the note. Record it now, match it once the note turns up.
storeReturns.countHint: Zero is valid and means nothing arrived. That is different from not yet counted, and it can only be recorded once.
storeReturns.pairBody: {doc}, worth {value}. Pick the shop note it belongs to.
storeReturns.pairNoCandidates: No shop note is waiting for a warehouse count.
storeReturns.compareTitle: Shop's claim against the warehouse count
storeReturns.compareHint: Red figures are goods that did not arrive as claimed.
storeReturns.noPhoto: No photo of the note yet. The photo is what the archive is made of.
storeReturns.warehousePending: The warehouse has not counted. While that is empty, the return deduction counts for nothing.
storeReturns.perItemHint: An item that did not arrive at all appears only on the claim side.
storeReturns.chargeOpenBody: The shop took {claimed} off the payment; the warehouse received {counted}. Until this is decided the invoice stays open and the salesman sees a “return held” flag.
storeReturns.chargeCompanyHint: “The company bears it” means the money is written off — pick it only when there is genuinely nobody to charge.
storeReturns.assignBody: The {gap} difference will be borne by {who}. This releases the invoice; recovering it runs on its own.
storeReturns.assignPlaceholder: e.g. deduct from next month's commission
storeReturns.markSettledHint: Does not change the receivable — the invoice was released when the difference was assigned.
storeReturns.usedInClaims: Used as a deduction on payment claims
storeReturns.usedInClaimsEmpty: This note has not been used to reduce any payment yet, so it is holding nothing.
storeReturns.cancelBody: Deductions already pointing at this note do NOT disappear — if the shop has already taken it off a payment, that money is still short and still owed. A cancelled note reads as zero physical, so its deductions are held in full until somebody corrects them.
storeReturns.emptyBody: Every return is settled, or no note has been recorded yet.
storeReturns.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
storeReturns.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: That note number is already used for this shop.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_DIHITUNG: This note already has a warehouse count. Unmatch it first if the count is wrong.
storeReturns.errBUKAN_YATIM: This receipt already has a match.
storeReturns.errBEDA_TOKO: This receipt is recorded against a different shop. If the shop is wrong, move it first with Move store.
storeReturns.errTIDAK_ADA_SELISIH: There is no difference to assign.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has already been assigned.
storeReturns.errBEBAN_SUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has been assigned — it can no longer be unmatched, cancelled or moved.
storeReturns.errBELUM_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has not been assigned yet.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_LUNAS: This charge is already marked paid back.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The number clashed with one just created. Try saving again.
storeReturns.itemsHint: May be left empty when only the total was recorded. Without detail all you see later is THAT there is a shortfall — not which item is short.
storeReturns.stockHint: Items picked from the catalogue will ADD to warehouse stock when this count is saved. Rows with only a typed name do not move stock.
storeReturns.photoHint: Required. These photos are what the archive is made of — a note without one leaves only a figure you cannot show the shop.
storeReturns.bearerPersonHint: A charge attaches to a person, not a role — that is what makes it appear on their screen and deductible from their commission.
storeReturns.moveBody: For a note recorded against the wrong store. The note, its warehouse count and any undecided difference move with it. Stock does not change — the goods did arrive. The reporting salesperson is notified.
storeReturns.moveCountBody: For a warehouse count recorded against the wrong store or no store. Once moved, it can be matched with a note from the target store. Stock does not change.
storeReturns.moveReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the salesperson picked the wrong store
storeReturns.okMoved: Note moved to the target store.
storeReturns.cancelCounted: The warehouse has already counted this note's goods and stock has gone up, so it cannot simply be cancelled. If the store is wrong, move it to the right store. If the count is wrong, unmatch it first.
storeReturns.errTOKO_SAMA: The target store is the current store.
storeReturns.errTOKO_TIDAK_AKTIF: The target store is no longer active.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_DIPAKAI_DI_TUJUAN: The target store already has an open note with the same number. If that one is correct, cancel this note instead.
storeReturns.errDIPAKAI_DI_BKM: This note is used as a deduction in {docNo}. Fix that payment report first (cancel it, or unlink the deduction).
storeReturns.errSUDAH_BERPASANGAN: This count is already matched to a note — move it through the note.
storeReturns.moveCountReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the warehouse picked the wrong store when counting
storeReturns.lockedCycleBody: This warehouse count falls in a month already locked in consignment cycle {cycles}. Moving it also changes that month's consigned stock in both stores, and printed reports may differ from the screen.
storeReturns.errSIKLUS_TERKUNCI: This month is locked in a consignment cycle — confirmation needed.
storeReturns.moveStoreBookLocked: This note has already taken goods off the store's stock book, so it cannot move to another store. Cancel it (the book is reversed), then record it again at the right store.
storeReturns.errADA_BUKU_TOKO: This note has already taken goods off the store's stock book, so it cannot move to another store. Cancel it, then record it again at the right store.
storeReturns.perVariantHint: Per item and variant. Condition: store claim → warehouse count. Only sellable goods go back into sellable stock.
storeReturns.errADA_BARIS_RUSAK: This note sends back damaged goods (from a delivery or from a shopper) that belong to its original store, so it cannot be moved. Cancel it and record it again at the right store.
storeReturns.countBodyButa: {doc} — count the goods that actually arrived. The store's claim is deliberately not shown here.
storeReturns.assignTokoInvoiceHint: The store is billed for what it already deducted beyond the goods that arrived — at most {value} — through a new invoice BEBAN/{doc}, due per the store's payment terms. If the store has not deducted this note yet, no invoice is made, and the note may afterwards only be deducted up to the goods that arrived.
storeReturns.errPENGHITUNG_SAMA_PELAPOR: The counter reported this note. The count must be recorded by someone else.
storeReturns.errHITUNGAN_KOSONG: Some lines have no quantity yet. Type 0 if nothing arrived.
storeReturns.errPENANGGUNG_WAJIB: Choose the salesperson who bears it.
storeReturns.errTOKO_KONSI: Consignment stores have no receivables, so the shortfall cannot be billed to the store. Record it as lost goods borne by the store, or choose another bearer.
storeReturns.errPIUTANG_BEBAN_SUDAH_DITAGIH: This store charge invoice is already in collection (a payment claim or collection note in any status, or an open collection task), so it cannot be removed and the charge can no longer be moved away from the store.
storeReturns.errDITAGIH_LEWAT_PIUTANG: A store charge is billed through its invoice. It is settled by a verified payment claim, not marked here.
storeReturns.errFOTO_BUKAN_MILIK: This return note photo was uploaded by someone else. Take your own photo of the note.
storeReturns.errFOTO_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: This return-note photo is identical to someone else's photo already used on another report. Take your own photo of the note.
storeReturns.searchPlaceholder: Search note no., store, or salesman
storeReturns.countOwnNote: You reported this note. Ask a warehouse colleague to count it.
storeReturns.claimHiddenBody: You may count this note, so the store's claim, its photo, and its deductions stay hidden until the warehouse saves its count.
storeReturns.assignTokoEstimate: Billed to the store if decided now: {value}.
storeReturns.assignTokoNothing: The store has not deducted more than the goods that arrived — nothing is billed to the store.
storeReturns.markSettledNothingBilled: Nothing was billed to the store, so there is nothing to mark as paid back.

foto.errTERLALU_BESAR: That photo is too large. 6 MB maximum after resizing.
foto.errTANPA_AKSES: Your session expired. Sign in again.
foto.savedOnPhone: Saved on the phone — uploads once there is a signal
foto.errBUKAN_MILIK: This photo was uploaded by someone else. Take your own photo.

arsipRetur.pageDescription: Every return note filed by shop. Open the folder, click the note.
arsipRetur.summary: {count} notes · {orphan} warehouse receipts with no note
arsipRetur.hangingExplain: A <tautan>red dot</tautan> on a folder means a note inside it is still hanging — not counted by the warehouse, not matched, or its difference not yet assigned.
arsipRetur.emptyFolderBody: This shop has never sent anything back.

imporPiutang.pageDescription: Upload an Excel or CSV file. Reviewed first, saved second — nothing goes in before you have seen it.
imporPiutang.pickFile: Choose an Excel or CSV file
imporPiutang.pickFileHint: Column headings are recognised automatically. The file is read in this browser and sent nowhere.
imporPiutang.noSisaColumn: This file has no outstanding column. Every invoice is treated as wholly unpaid — outstanding equals the full amount.
imporPiutang.previewHint: Amber rows will not be imported. The reason is in the last column.
imporPiutang.historyLocked: Already in use — cannot be reverted
imporPiutang.revertBody: {count} invoices will be deleted. If even one is already on a collection note or settled by a claim, the whole revert is refused.
imporPiutang.revertReasonPlaceholder: e.g. columns swapped, wrong period, same file uploaded twice
imporPiutang.revertInUse: Cannot revert: these invoices are already in use — {list}
imporPiutang.revertErrTIDAK_DITEMUKAN: That import record was not found.
imporPiutang.revertErrBUKAN_IMPOR: That record is not an import.
imporPiutang.revertErrTANPA_AKSES: You are not allowed to revert an import.
imporPiutang.skipBARIS_BERMASALAH: Something in this row could not be read.
imporPiutang.skipTOKO_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The shop code or name matches no shop.
imporPiutang.skipTOKO_KONSI: Consignment shop. Goods there are still ours until they sell, so no receivable is born from it.
imporPiutang.skipLUNAS: Outstanding is zero — the invoice is settled and needs no receivable.
imporPiutang.errJudulTidakKetemu: No heading row found in the first 20 rows.
imporPiutang.errKolomWajib: An invoice number and an amount column are required. Check the headings.
imporPiutang.errBacaBerkas: The file could not be read. Make sure it is Excel or CSV.
imporPiutang.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to import invoices.
imporPiutang.columnsRequired: Required columns: invoice no. and amount. Also recognised: store code, store name, invoice date, due date, outstanding, sales.
imporPiutang.skipSESUDAH_TANGGAL_MULAI: Dated on or after the ledger start date. Import is only for old invoices; new invoices are made through orders and deliveries.

fakturManual.title: Manual invoice
fakturManual.body: Type an invoice that did not arrive in a file. Add the item lines if you have them — those are what can be checked against the shop's copy later.
fakturManual.itemsHint: May be left empty. If filled, the invoice amount is computed from it.
fakturManual.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to create invoices.
fakturManual.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
fakturManual.errTOKO_KONSI: A consignment shop creates no receivable — the goods are still ours until they sell.
fakturManual.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: The invoice amount must be more than zero.
fakturManual.errTEMPO_SEBELUM_FAKTUR: The due date cannot come before the invoice date.
fakturManual.errSESUDAH_TANGGAL_MULAI: The invoice date is on or after the ledger start date. From that date, store invoices for goods are made through orders and deliveries (nota tagihan), so stock and cost of goods are recorded too.

dasborPelunasan.pageDescription: What is holding money today, and whose turn it is.
dasborPelunasan.todoHint: Ordered by risk. Click a row to work on it.
dasborPelunasan.todoEmptyBody: No invoices past their promised payment or due date, no claims waiting, and no unfinished returns.
dasborPelunasan.why_lewat: {toko} — {hari} days past the promise and the money has not arrived.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim: {toko} — reported {hari} days ago, not yet matched against the statement.
dasborPelunasan.why_tertahan: {toko} — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received.
dasborPelunasan.why_cek: {toko} — the goods are not recorded as received.
dasborPelunasan.why_keputusan: {toko} — the warehouse received less than claimed and nobody bears it.
dasborPelunasan.why_jodoh: Goods arrived with no shop note and need matching.
dasborPelunasan.photoOrphan: {count} of them belong to no document ({size}) — swept automatically each night.
dasborPelunasan.why_lewat_today: {toko} — the promise falls today and the money has not arrived.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim_today: {toko} — reported today, not yet matched against the statement.
dasborPelunasan.why_tertahan_today: {toko} — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received.
dasborPelunasan.why_cek_today: {toko} — the goods are not recorded as received.
dasborPelunasan.why_keputusan_today: {toko} — the warehouse received less than claimed and nobody bears it.
dasborPelunasan.why_jodoh_today: Goods arrived with no shop note and need matching.
dasborPelunasan.why_jatuh_tempo: {toko} — {hari} days past due and not yet on a collection note.
dasborPelunasan.why_jatuh_tempo_today: {toko} — due today and not yet on a collection note.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim_oleh: {toko} — reported by {pelapor} {hari} days ago, not yet matched against the bank statement.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim_oleh_today: {toko} — reported by {pelapor} today, not yet matched against the bank statement.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim_milikSaya: {toko} — you recorded this {hari} days ago. Another finance admin matches it against the bank statement.
dasborPelunasan.why_klaim_milikSaya_today: {toko} — you recorded this today. Another finance admin matches it against the bank statement.

bebanSelisih.pageDescription: The gap between a shop's return claim and the warehouse count, and who carries it.
bebanSelisih.emptyBody: Every counted return matches what its shop claimed.
bebanSelisih.explain: While a difference is carried by nobody it holds the related invoice open. Assigning it releases the invoice; recovering the money runs on its own, and that is what “paid back” records as finished.
bebanSelisih.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
bebanSelisih.errBELUM_DIPUTUSKAN: This has not been assigned yet.
bebanSelisih.errSUDAH_LUNAS: This is already marked paid back.
bebanSelisih.reassignBody: Change who carries it. A charge already paid back cannot be moved — moving it would make that payment record a lie.
bebanSelisih.orphanWarning: {count} charges are assigned to a salesman without naming one. Until that is fixed they appear on nobody's screen — reassign to complete them.
bebanSelisih.reassignToTokoHint: A new invoice is created for the store for what it already deducted beyond the goods that arrived, at most {value}.
bebanSelisih.reassignFromTokoHint: Invoice {no} will be removed — only possible while it has not been collected.
bebanSelisih.errPENANGGUNG_WAJIB: Choose the salesperson who bears it.
bebanSelisih.errTOKO_KONSI: Consignment stores have no receivables, so the shortfall cannot be billed to the store. Record it as lost goods borne by the store, or choose another bearer.
bebanSelisih.errPIUTANG_BEBAN_SUDAH_DITAGIH: This store charge invoice is already in collection (a payment claim or collection note in any status, or an open collection task), so it cannot be removed and the charge can no longer be moved away from the store.
bebanSelisih.errDITAGIH_LEWAT_PIUTANG: A store charge is billed through its invoice. It is settled by a verified payment claim, not marked here.
bebanSelisih.errTIDAK_ADA_SELISIH: There is no shortfall to assign.
bebanSelisih.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The invoice number clashed with one just created. Try saving again.
bebanSelisih.markSettledNothingBilled: Nothing was billed to the store.

pwaPiutang.why_klaim: You reported a transfer on {doc}. Finance has not seen the money arrive yet, so it does not count as settled.
pwaPiutang.why_tertahan: {value} held by a return — the deduction does not match what the warehouse received. The invoice cannot reach zero until the difference is resolved.
pwaPiutang.why_lewat: The shop promised {date} — {days} days past and the money has not arrived. Chase it and get a new date.
pwaPiutang.why_tt: On collection note {doc}. The shop promised {date} — wait for the date.
pwaPiutang.why_belum: Ready for a collection note — nothing hanging and nothing overdue.

pwaBkm.why_DIKIRIM: Reported. Finance has not matched it against the bank statement yet, so the receivable has not dropped.
pwaBkm.why_DIBATALKAN: This report was voided because it was entered wrong, not because the money was missing.
pwaBkm.why_giro_MENUNGGU: The giro has not cleared yet. The receivable only drops once it clears into the account and finance records it.

pwaRetur.empty: You have not recorded any return notes.
pwaRetur.why_cek: Waiting for the warehouse to count. Until then the deduction is not recognised.
pwaRetur.why_keputusan: The warehouse received less than the shop claimed. Finance is deciding who bears the difference.
pwaRetur.why_jodoh: Not yet matched to a warehouse receipt.
pwaRetur.why_beres: Done — claim and physical agree, or the difference has been borne.
pwaRetur.newBody: Photograph the note first, then copy its number and value from the photo.
pwaRetur.photoHint: Required. This photo is what the archive is made of and what the warehouse looks at when counting.
pwaRetur.noNrtHint: Copy it exactly from the shop's note, not one of ours.
pwaRetur.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to record return notes.
pwaRetur.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
pwaRetur.errNOMOR_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: That note number is already used for this shop.
pwaRetur.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: The value must be more than zero.
pwaRetur.okQueued: Saved on the phone. The return note sends by itself once there is a signal.
pwaRetur.errKUNCI_DIPAKAI: This note clashes with another salesperson's upload. Photograph it again.
pwaRetur.kurangFoto: Take a photo of the return note first.
pwaRetur.kurangNomor: Fill in the store's note number.
pwaRetur.kurangNilai: Fill in the amount the store claims.
pwaRetur.salinan: Copied from {doc}. The number, amount, date and photo (if any) are filled in — check them, then choose the right store.
pwaRetur.errPENGGANTI_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The note to replace was not found.
pwaRetur.errPENGGANTI_MASIH_BERLAKU: The old note is still active. Withdraw it before recording again.
pwaRetur.errPENGGANTI_BUKAN_MILIK: The old note is not yours.
pwaRetur.errSUDAH_DIGANTI: The old note already has a replacement — the same goods cannot be reported twice.
pwaRetur.errTOKO_TIDAK_DIIZINKAN: You may not record a return for this store.
pwaRetur.errBARANG_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: Some goods were not recognised. Choose them again.
pwaRetur.errFOTO_WAJIB: Take a photo of the store's return note first.
pwaRetur.errRUSAK_TIDAK_SAH: These damaged delivery goods cannot be sent back from this store (not yet decided by the warehouse, not this store's, or a different item).
pwaRetur.errRUSAK_MELEBIHI: The quantity sent back exceeds the damaged pieces not yet returned.
pwaRetur.errRETUR_PEMBELI_TIDAK_SAH: This shopper-returned damaged item cannot be sent back from this store (not this store's shopper return, a different item, or its condition is sellable).
pwaRetur.errRETUR_PEMBELI_MELEBIHI: The quantity sent back exceeds the shopper-returned damaged pieces not yet sent.
pwaRetur.errFOTO_BUKAN_MILIK: This return note photo was uploaded by someone else. Take your own photo of the note.
pwaRetur.errFOTO_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: This return-note photo is identical to someone else's photo already used on another report. Take your own photo of the note.

pwaBeban.empty: No return difference is charged to you.
pwaBeban.whyOpen: This difference is charged to you and has not been paid back.

pwaGudang.countBody: {doc} — the shop claims {claimed}. Enter the value of what actually arrived.
pwaGudang.countHint: Zero is valid and means nothing arrived. It can only be recorded once.
pwaGudang.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to count returns.
pwaGudang.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
pwaGudang.errSUDAH_DIHITUNG: This note has already been counted.
pwaGudang.perBarisHint: Count each line: the quantity that arrived and its condition.
pwaGudang.tidakMasukStok: Does not go into sellable stock.
pwaGudang.nilaiPerBarisHint: Filled in from the line counts. You may change it — the figure saved is the one written here.
pwaGudang.countBodyButa: {doc} · {store}. Count the goods that actually arrived. The store's claim is shown after the count is saved.
pwaGudang.milikSendiri: You reported this note. Ask a warehouse colleague to count it.
pwaGudang.qtyBelumDiisi: Fill in the quantity received on every line — type 0 if nothing arrived.
pwaGudang.hasilBody: {nri} for note {doc}. The store's claim can now be seen.
pwaGudang.hasilSelisih: {value} short of the claim — the office decides who bears it.
pwaGudang.hasilCocok: Received equals or exceeds the claim. No shortfall.
pwaGudang.errPENGHITUNG_SAMA_PELAPOR: You reported this note. Someone else must count it.
pwaGudang.errHITUNGAN_KOSONG: Some lines have no quantity yet. Type 0 if nothing arrived.

konsinyasi.pageDescription: One cycle = one shop × one month. Each row names its stage and whose turn it is.
konsinyasi.summary: {count} cycles · {late} SPG salaries past their date
konsinyasi.lateWarning: {count} cycles have an SPG salary past its date. This is the one that gets forgotten.
konsinyasi.why_laporan: One of the two reports has not arrived. With only one there is nothing to compare.
konsinyasi.why_cocok: Both reports are in but the figures are not locked. There is no official number yet.
konsinyasi.why_bayar_spg: Figures are locked; the SPG commission has not been paid.
konsinyasi.why_nota: Salary settled. The sales admin has not issued a nota.
konsinyasi.why_pajak: The nota exists. The tax admin has not recorded the tax invoice number.
konsinyasi.why_selesai: Chain complete — all three numbers present and the shop's bill is paid.
konsinyasi.emptyBody: Open a cycle for a consignment shop for the month you want to reconcile.
konsinyasi.spgDueHint: Its own date, separate from every other deadline — so the SPG salary stops losing to noisier work.
konsinyasi.openCycleBody: One cycle per shop per month. Every report, the official figures, and all three document numbers hang off it.
konsinyasi.shipBody: Goods sent to a consignment shop. Consigned stock is shipped minus sold.
konsinyasi.threeNumbersHint: They may be entirely unrelated. Side by side here so nobody has to ask which nota number it was.
konsinyasi.compareHint: The SPG reports by email, the shop by carrier. Red rows differ, or appear in only one report.
konsinyasi.reportBody: Copy it as it stands. Corrections happen when the figures are locked, not here.
konsinyasi.lockBody: These figures — not either raw report — bill the shop, pay the commission and reduce consigned stock. Prefilled from the store's report (the valid one); the SPG report is only a cross-check. Correct what needs correcting.
konsinyasi.baseSalaryHint: Base salary is whole for each; only the commission is split.
konsinyasi.commissionFromMaster: The per-piece commission rate is taken from the item master at lock time and copied onto the official line — changing the rate next month does not change this month's commission.
konsinyasi.openCharge: Still owes {value} in return charges — consider netting it off this commission.
konsinyasi.stockHint: Goods at the shop now, per item and size — the same count as the shop page. A shop with an SPG stock book is read from that book (received, sold and SPG counts). A shop without one is read from the consignment count: every shipment and approved consignment order, minus the official sold figures of ALL locked cycles, final returns, written-off damaged goods and decided lost goods. Sales are reported per item, so per-size figures are split in proportion to shipments and marked ≈. Months not yet locked reduce nothing. A negative figure means the shop reported selling more than was ever shipped.
konsinyasi.stockEmpty: No goods at this shop yet.
konsinyasi.recordNotaBody: The sales admin's number. It may be entirely unrelated to ours.
konsinyasi.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
konsinyasi.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
konsinyasi.errTOKO_BUKAN_KONSI: That shop is not a consignment shop.
konsinyasi.errSIKLUS_SUDAH_ADA: A cycle for that shop and month already exists.
konsinyasi.errPERIODE_TIDAK_VALID: That month or year is not valid.
konsinyasi.errSUDAH_DIKUNCI: The figures are locked. Unlock them first.
konsinyasi.errBELUM_DIKUNCI: The figures are not locked yet.
konsinyasi.errLAPORAN_BELUM_LENGKAP: Both reports must arrive first — locking on one means locking a figure that was never compared to anything.
konsinyasi.errADA_GAJI_SUDAH_DIBAYAR: A salary has already been paid. Unlocking after that means the commission could be recomputed smaller than what is already in someone's pocket.
konsinyasi.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: One of the figures is not valid.
konsinyasi.errSUDAH_DIBAYAR: This salary is already marked paid.

spgFill.hint: Fill in from the SPG sales receipts for this store in the cycle month. The rows below are replaced — check them, then save.
spgFill.empty: No SPG sales recorded for this month yet.
spgFill.done: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} filled in from SPG sales. Check, then save.

konsinyasi.matchHint: Sales in the store stock book compared with the SPG report and the store report. Only for cycles not locked yet.

tagihan.title: Bill to the store
tagihan.hint: Official sales minus the promo discount Elorae carries, plus the lost-goods charge assigned to the store.
tagihan.loss: Lost goods charged to the store
tagihan.totalAfterLock: Available once the figures are locked
tagihan.promoLive: Calculated live from this month's SPG receipts; frozen when locked.
tagihan.promoChanged: This month's SPG receipts changed after locking — the receipts now give an Elorae discount of {value}. The bill keeps the frozen figure; unlock to recalculate.
tagihan.storeShare: The store's share of a promo reduces the store's own margin and does not change the bill.
tagihan.lockPreview: The promo discount Elorae carries ({promo}) is frozen too — bill to the store {total}, before any lost-goods charge.
tagihan.paymentsHint: Instalments allowed. Finance records them once the money shows in the bank; the remainder is computed from the bill frozen at lock.
tagihan.recordBody: Remaining bill {value}. Only record money that already shows in the bank statement.
tagihan.cancelBody: The {value} payment of {date} stops reducing the bill. The row stays on record with its reason.

cocokBuku.title: Stock book reconciliation
cocokBuku.hint: The store stock book (kept by the SPG) compared with the consignment sales reports, per product. Sizes and colours are merged because the reports only go down to the product.
cocokBuku.diff: {count, plural, one {# product differs} other {# products differ}}
cocokBuku.noBook: This store does not use the stock book yet — only the SPG report, the store report and the official figures are compared.
cocokBuku.bookStarted: The store stock book only started on {date} — sales from the book cover that date onwards.
cocokBuku.lost: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} possibly lost, {pcs} pcs. Figures only — lost goods are recorded separately.
cocokBuku.notaHint: SPG receipts (net, by receipt date) are for comparison only and do not decide a difference.
cocokBuku.stockHint: Expected at the store = consigned stock − in process: shipments the SPG has not received, returns the warehouse has not counted, goods damaged on arrival that have not entered the book, and damaged goods returned by shoppers that have not gone back to the warehouse.
cocokBuku.provisional: Months not locked yet use provisional figures: {months}.
cocokBuku.recordedLostHint: Goods already recorded lost — from a stock count, a short delivery, or recorded by the office against the store book — are not counted again as possibly lost.
cocokBuku.keteranganSel: — = no such source yet (report not in, store without a book, or cycle not locked). 0 = the source exists but does not list this item.

konsinyasi.why_bayar_toko: The nota and tax invoice exist; the shop has not paid its bill in full. Finance records each payment once the money shows in the bank account.
konsinyasi.errADA_NOTA: A nota number has been recorded. The nota states the amount already billed to the shop, so the figures can no longer be unlocked.
konsinyasi.errADA_FAKTUR_PAJAK: A tax invoice number has been recorded. It states the amount already reported to the tax office, so the figures can no longer be unlocked.
konsinyasi.errADA_PEMBAYARAN_TOKO: The shop has already paid part or all of this bill. Cancel any wrongly recorded payment (with a reason) before unlocking.
konsinyasi.errMELEBIHI_SISA: The amount is more than the remaining bill. Check again — part of it may already be recorded.
konsinyasi.errTANGGAL_DI_DEPAN: The payment date cannot be after today.
konsinyasi.errSTOK_KURANG: There is not enough warehouse stock for this shipment. The details are above the item list.
konsinyasi.errVARIAN_WAJIB: Choose a size for items that have variants.

kirimBaris.emptyHint: Add the items being shipped. Items with variants are shipped per size.
kirimBaris.variantHidden: {count} sizes without stock are not shown.
kirimBaris.noStock: This item has no available stock in the warehouse.
kirimBaris.overAvailable: More than the available warehouse stock ({qty}).
kirimBaris.stockHint: Catalog items leave the warehouse stock when the shipment is saved. Items typed by name only are recorded without moving stock.
kirimBaris.shortTitle: Not enough warehouse stock, so nothing was saved:
kirimBaris.whyQty: Row {n}: enter the quantity (a whole number above zero).
kirimBaris.whyLoadFailed: Row {n}: the sizes of {item} could not be loaded. Press Try again.

jenisPotongan.pageDescription: The deductions allowed on a payment claim, and the rules attached to each.
jenisPotongan.methodHint_PERSEN: The amount is a percentage of the invoice.
jenisPotongan.methodHint_DARI_RETUR: MUST be linked to a return note. That link is what holds the amount until the warehouse finishes counting — without this type, linking depends entirely on whoever is typing remembering to.
jenisPotongan.ruleNoteHint: A deduction of this type cannot be saved without an explanation.
jenisPotongan.rulePkpHint: A marker only — Elorae has no taxable flag on a shop, so nothing enforces it yet.
jenisPotongan.ruleManualHint: When off, this type may only arrive from another process, not be typed by an admin.
jenisPotongan.ruleActiveHint: Inactive types do not appear when creating a claim, but stay attached to older ones.
jenisPotongan.formBody: The rules chosen here are enforced when a claim is saved, not merely displayed.
jenisPotongan.emptyBody: While the list is empty, deduction names are typed freehand on every claim.
jenisPotongan.explain: Types are NOT deleted, only disabled. One that has been used stays attached to older claims, and deleting it would strip the name off historical deductions — old reports would change after being closed.
jenisPotongan.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to change deduction types.
jenisPotongan.errNAMA_SUDAH_ADA: That name is already used by another type.
jenisPotongan.disableBody: New payment claims can no longer pick this type. Older claims that already use it are unchanged.
jenisPotongan.peranJurnalOtomatis: Automatic — sales discount, or prepaid PPh 23 when PKP stores only
jenisPotongan.peranJurnalHint: The account role debited when finance verifies a BKM carrying this deduction. The account itself is set in Finance → Account Mapping.
jenisPotongan.errPERAN_TIDAK_SAH: That journal account cannot be used for a deduction.

migration.title: Bulk migration
migration.subtitle: Push ERP-source FINISHED_GOOD items to Jubelio in bulk. Only items without an existing Jubelio mapping are shown. Worker drains queued rows over time — watch progress on the <link>outbox dashboard</link>.

Items with unmapped categories will SKIP — fix them on <categories>/backoffice/jubelio/categories</categories> first to avoid SKIP rows. Rollback for individual items is available on the <settings>Jubelio settings</settings> page (Test cleanup card).

spgRequests.emptyOther: No requests with this status yet.

storeProposals.dupNone: No similar store or other proposal.

storeProposals.marginHint: Consignment stores only, below 100%. Can be filled in later in the store master.

form.label: Store class
form.tanpa: No class — use the general interval ({days} days)
form.tanpaTanpaHari: No class — use the general interval
form.bantuan: Sets how often salespeople are reminded to visit this store. The interval per class is set in Settings → Salesman.

rencana.batasCampurBawaan: Unpaid bills, ordering less, or past their class's visit gap (stores without a class: {days} days).

halaman.subjudul: Suggested A/B/C classes from purchases over the last {days} days. The class sets how often salespeople visit a store.
halaman.caraIsi: Stores are ranked by their purchases over the last {days} days. Outright stores: rupiah value of delivery notes. Stores that bought nothing get no suggestion.
halaman.konsiCatatan: Consignment stores are ranked separately by the number of pieces approved for shipment, because consignment orders carry no purchase price — their rupiah is not comparable with outright stores.
halaman.otomatisNyala: Automatic class is on: stores without a class already use their suggestion for the visit interval. Applying the suggestion here makes it a fixed class.
halaman.otomatisMati: Automatic class is off: stores without a class use the general visit interval until a class is set.
halaman.jumlah: {count, plural, =0 {no stores} one {# store} other {# stores}}
halaman.kosongBerbeda: Every store already matches its suggestion.
halaman.pilihSemua: Select all that can be applied
halaman.konfirmasiJudul: Apply the suggestion to {count, plural, =1 {1 store} other {# stores}}?
halaman.konfirmasiIsi: The selected stores' class is replaced by the suggestion, and the salespeople's visit interval for those stores changes with it. Every change is recorded in the audit trail and can be changed again from the store form.
halaman.berhasil: {count, plural, =0 {No store changed} =1 {1 store updated} other {# stores updated}}
halaman.errForbidden: You do not have permission to change store data.
halaman.errInvalid: Invalid store selection. Reload the page and try again.
halaman.tersembunyiTanpaBeli: {count, plural, one {# store has} other {# stores have}} no purchases yet
halaman.tersembunyiSesuai: {count, plural, one {# store already matches} other {# stores already match}} the suggestion
halaman.kosongTanpaUsulan: No class suggestion can be applied.

pengaturan.penjelasan: Class A stores are visited more often than class C stores. Stores without a class use the general visit interval above.
pengaturan.hariIsi: Visit interval per class, 1–{max} days. The visit plan on the salespeople's phones uses it to decide which stores are due.
pengaturan.otomatis: Automatic class for stores without a class
pengaturan.otomatisIsi: Stores that have not been given a class use the class suggested by their purchases over the last 180 days. A class set by an admin always wins.
pengaturan.persenTidakSah: Check the A and B figures
pengaturan.persenIsi: Used for class suggestions: stores are ranked by purchases; outright and consignment stores are ranked separately. Stores that bought nothing get no suggestion.
pengaturan.ringkasan: Active stores: {a} class A · {b} class B · {c} class C · {tanpa} without a class.
pengaturan.ringkasanTanpaAngka: The class of each store is set in the store master.
pengaturan.errInvalid: Invalid figures. Intervals are 1–365 days; A and B are at least 1% each and add up to at most 99%.
pengaturan.errForbidden: You do not have permission to change salesman settings.

giro.pageDescription: Giro slips held by the office that have not become money yet. The receivable only drops once a giro is marked cleared.
giro.emptyBody: Giros appear here once a salesperson reports a payment made by giro.
giro.recentEmpty: No giro has cleared or bounced in the last 30 days.
giro.expired: The 70-day validity has run out — this slip can no longer be presented. Ask the store to replace it.
giro.clearBody: Mark it cleared only if {value} is already in the account. The claim is verified at once and its receivables are recalculated.
giro.bounceBody: The claim is rejected and the receivable stays open. The salesperson who reported it receives this reason — write what they need to tell the store.
giro.okCleared: Giro marked cleared; the claim is verified and receivables recalculated.
giro.okBounced: Giro marked bounced. The salesperson will be told.
giro.errTIDAK_DITEMUKAN: Claim not found — it may have been deleted.
giro.errSUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: This claim was already decided. Reload the page.
giro.errGIRO_BELUM_CAIR: This giro has not cleared yet.
giro.errBUKAN_GIRO_MENUNGGU: This giro was already decided. Reload the page.
giro.errGAGAL: Could not save the decision. Try again.
giro.cardHint: A giro is not money yet. Deposit it at the bank; once it clears into the account, mark it cleared here.
giro.errPEMERIKSA_SAMA: You reported or recorded this giro payment receipt, so you cannot decide it yourself. Ask another finance admin to review it.
giro.errMELEBIHI_SISA: This invoice was already settled by another payment receipt that was verified first. Reject this giro or ask the salesperson to correct the amount.
giro.errRETUR_TERPAKAI: A return note on this giro receipt is deducted beyond what can still be deducted. Reject one of the receipts first.
giro.pemeriksaSamaSingkat: Your own receipt — another finance admin decides it.
giro.errRETUR_DITAHAN: The invoice on this giro receipt is still held by a return deduction on another verified receipt, and this giro falls into that held part. Wait until the return is settled, or reject this giro.

konsiIsiUlang.title: Consignment store refills
konsiIsiUlang.subtitle: Consignment stores and stores with an SPG: those whose stock has reached the minimum, and goods sitting unsold for 60 days. Worked by the office before salesperson routes are planned.
konsiIsiUlang.meta: {stores} stores need a refill · {pcs} pcs · {slow} rows not selling
konsiIsiUlang.refillHint: Quantities run up to the maximum target, minus goods already in progress, and are capped by warehouse stock.
konsiIsiUlang.noTargetCount: {count} stores have no min/max targets — without targets there is no refill suggestion.
konsiIsiUlang.refillEmptyBody: Every store with targets is still above its minimum. Turn off the filter to see all stores.
konsiIsiUlang.warehouseNote: Each store's suggestion is capped by warehouse stock on its own, yet these stores draw on the same warehouse. If stock is thin, split it before shipping.
konsiIsiUlang.slowHint: Still on the shelf with no sale in 60 days. The move suggestion points to another store in the same area that sold the same item in the last 60 days.

konsiIsiUlang.noSuggestion: No store in the same area sells it

konsiIsiUlang.tanpaTargetJudul: {count} stores have no min/max targets yet, so they get no refill suggestion:

kartu.penjelasan: The estimated-commission scheme salespeople see on their phones and in the commission report. What is paid is still the office's decision.
kartu.aktifIsi: Off: the incentive card disappears from salespeople's phones and the report shows zero.
kartu.dasarTERTAGIHIsi: From payments finance has verified. Sales a store hasn't paid for earn no commission.
kartu.dasarPENJUALANIsi: From sales as on the "This month" card: outright deliveries, consignment sold in store (at Elorae's price), van sales.
kartu.tarifDasarIsi: Percent of the basis, for every salesperson except those given a special rate.
kartu.bagianPenagihIsi: Stores change hands, so invoices are often collected by someone other than the seller. This percent of the money goes to the collector, the rest to the seller. Invoices without a seller go entirely to the collector.
kartu.bagianPenagihTakBerlaku: Only applies when the basis is money collected.
kartu.tingkatIsi: The rate rises once sales reach a given percent of the monthly target. The highest rate reached is used.
kartu.tanpaTingkat: No tiers — every achievement uses the base rate.
kartu.tarifKhususIsi: Leave empty to use the base rate. Tiered rates still apply when higher.
kartu.tanpaSalesman: No users with a salesperson role yet.
kartu.peringkatNamaIsi: Off: colleagues appear as "Salesperson #n"; everyone still sees their own name. Colleagues' sales are never shown.
kartu.hanyaBaca: Only field-sales order approvers can change this scheme.
kartu.perkiraanSaja: The figures on salespeople's phones are estimates from this scheme.
kartu.isianTakSah: Check the inputs: percents 0–100 with at most two decimals, and tier thresholds must not repeat.
kartu.errForbidden: You don't have permission to change the commission scheme.

laporan.title: Salesperson commission
laporan.description: Each salesperson's estimated commission per month from the scheme in Settings → Salesman — the same figures they see on their phones. The office's basis for deciding the commission paid.
laporan.inactive: Commission is switched off in settings — every commission is zero.
laporan.errForbidden: You don't have permission to view the commission report.
laporan.schemeTERTAGIH: Basis: verified collections · base rate {rate}% · {tiers} tiers · collector's share {split}%.
laporan.emptyDescription: Salespeople appear here once there are users with a salesperson role or verified collections this month.
laporan.footnote: Estimate. Collected = money actually received from payments finance verified that month; return and promotion deductions are left out, and unverified reports count as zero. Sales and achievement match the "This month" card on the salesperson's phone.

minimumPesanan.penjelasan: Minimum quantity per product for outright orders. Stores that already have an approved outright order use the reorder minimum.
minimumPesanan.pertamaIsi: For stores without an approved outright order yet. Empty = {bawaan} pcs.
minimumPesanan.ulangIsi: For stores that already have one. Empty = same as the first order.
minimumPesanan.ringkasan: In effect: first order {pertama} pcs, reorder {ulang} pcs per product (all variants combined).
minimumPesanan.barangSendiri: Products with their own minimum in the product master keep that number at every store.

promoBonus.barangHadiahIsi: Leave empty to give the same product that was bought.
promoBonus.ringkasanSama: For every {beli} pcs bought, the store gets {gratis} pcs of the same product free.
promoBonus.ringkasanLain: For every {beli} pcs bought, the store gets {gratis} pcs of {barang} free.
promoBonus.catatanStok: Quantity bought is counted per product (all variants combined). If the free product is short, what is in stock is given and the shortfall is noted on the order — an order is never held back by a bonus.
promoBonus.errJumlah: Enter whole numbers of at least 1 for the quantity bought and the quantity free.
promoBonus.kurangStok: Bonus stock is short by {qty} pcs for {produk} — the shortfall is noted on the order.
promoBonus.barangDibeliIsi: Products whose purchases count. Pieces of several products are added together; each product joins only one bonus promo.

biayaPerjalanan.deskripsi: Fuel, parking, toll and meal claims from salespeople. Supervisors approve or reject; finance marks them paid.
biayaPerjalanan.ringkasMeta: {n, plural, one {# claim} other {# claims}} · {nilai} · {menunggu} awaiting a decision
biayaPerjalanan.kosongIsi: Claims submitted by salespeople from their phones appear here.
biayaPerjalanan.kosongSaringIsi: Change the status or salesperson filter.
biayaPerjalanan.rincianDeskripsi: Submitted by {salesman} for a receipt dated {tanggal}.
biayaPerjalanan.milikSendiri: This is your own claim — someone else has to decide on it.
biayaPerjalanan.tanpaFoto: This claim was submitted without a receipt photo.
biayaPerjalanan.okSetujui: Claim approved. The salesperson has been notified.
biayaPerjalanan.okTolak: Claim rejected. The salesperson has been notified.
biayaPerjalanan.okBayar: Claim marked paid. The salesperson has been notified.

pengaturan.penjelasan: Stores order by themselves through a link from their salesperson or the office, without a visit. These orders are marked "Store portal" and await office approval.
pengaturan.aktif: Turn on the store order portal
pengaturan.aktifIsi: When off, EVERY store link stops working immediately and no new link can be created.
pengaturan.masaBerlakuIsi: {min}–{maks} days. Existing links are not changed.
pengaturan.maksPesananIsi: {min}–{maks}. A brake in case a link leaks to someone else.
pengaturan.aturanSama: Prices, promos, order minimums and credit limits apply exactly as for salesperson orders. Stores never see stock numbers, only Available/Limited/Sold out.

inden.deskripsi: Order windows for goods not yet in the warehouse. The office opens a window with a closing date and a delivery range; salespeople take orders from their phones; once the goods arrive, the office releases it and the orders are prepared for delivery.
inden.kosongSaringIsi: Change the search or pick another state.
inden.kosongIsi: Create a pre-order for goods still in production so stores can order them before they arrive.
inden.baruDeskripsi: Pick the goods that can be ordered before they arrive, the date orders close, and when delivery is promised. All dates are WIB.

ringkas.belumDirilisIsi: Held when the pre-order is released

rilis.isi: Press once the pre-order goods have been received and recorded in the warehouse. Stock for every approved order is held right away; pending orders are held when approved. From release on, pre-orders can be delivered and this window stops taking orders. A release cannot be undone.
rilis.sudah: This pre-order was already released. Nothing changed.
rilis.berhasil: Pre-order released. Stock held for {pesanan} orders ({baris} lines).
rilis.kurangStok: Stock for {n} items is short of the orders — an oversell warning was raised.
rilis.belumTercatat: Cannot release yet: these goods are not recorded in the warehouse — {barang}. Record their receipt (per variant), then release again.
rilis.gagal: Failed to release the pre-order. Try again.

tolak.TANPA_IZIN: You are not allowed to release pre-orders.

rilis.konfirmasiIsi: Stock for {disetujui} approved orders is held now; {menunggu} pending orders are held when approved. Make sure the warehouse has received the goods. A release cannot be undone.
rilis.konfirmasiMasihBuka: This window is still open — after release salespeople can no longer order through it.

inden.barangIsi: Pcs ordered by stores against the production plan, per item and per variant. Rejected orders and closed remainders are not counted.
inden.pesananKosongIsi: Orders appear here as soon as a salesperson records a pre-order from their phone.

form.kirimBantu: The range promised to stores. Optional.
form.aktifBantu: Turn off to stop taking orders without changing the dates.
form.bagianBarangIsi: Only these items can be ordered through the pre-order. Planned = quantity to be produced; leave blank if unknown. The plan does not limit orders.
form.belumAdaBarang: No items yet. Add at least one.
form.tidakBisaHapus: Already ordered by stores — cannot be removed

targetSales.deskripsi: Targets per category and per product for each salesperson and SPG, by month — alongside the total target in Settings → Salesman. Set by order approvers. A salesperson's achievement matches the turnover on their phone home (delivered outright sales, consignment sold in store at Elorae's price, van sales) — an approved consignment transfer is not a sale; an SPG's comes from their in-store sales receipts, minus items returned by shoppers.

pengumuman.deskripsi: Office messages to the field team — salesmen, SPGs, or both. They appear on the home screen and menu of their phones; those that require acknowledgement ask them to tap "I understand". The detail page shows who has read it.
pengumuman.kosongSaringIsi: Change the search or pick another state.
pengumuman.kosongIsi: Send news to the field team — price changes, meeting schedules, new targets — and see who has read it.

aturan.judul: How promos are applied at the counter
aturan.pengantar: Several promos can run at once. This is the order the sale screen and the receipt use:
aturan.satu: One piece gets at most one product promo (percentage off, rupiah off, special price, or buy X get Y free).
aturan.prioritas: Higher priority goes first. At the same priority each piece gets the biggest discount; buy X get Y free then uses the pieces left over.
aturan.paket: Buy X get Y free may mix products in that promo: pieces are sorted from the most expensive, and in every full group of X+Y the Y cheapest pieces are free.
aturan.belanja: After product promos, at most ONE minimum-spend promo — the one with the biggest discount — is applied to the net value of the products in that promo.
aturan.manual: The SPG's manual discount (when switched on in Settings → SPG) comes last, on the receipt's net value, and cannot exceed its percentage limit.
aturan.waktu: A promo is judged at the time of sale: a receipt made without signal and sent the next morning still gets that day's promo.

pemakaian.catatan: Values as recorded on the receipt, before shopper returns. Product-promo discounts on receipts that also got a spend promo or a manual discount are attributed back to their promo by line value.

kinerjaSpg.deskripsi: Attendance, sales, visitors and day closing for every SPG in one month. Read by the SPG supervisors to assess and coach; the figures come from the SPG phones and the shift schedule.
kinerjaSpg.kosongIsi: No SPG held a store, recorded a receipt, was scheduled, or counted visitors this month.
kinerjaSpg.kosongSaringIsi: This store has no SPG or SPG activity this month. Pick another month or store.

sel.tanpaTarget: No target set for this month
sel.belumDisusun: No shift schedule has been made for this SPG at this store

keterangan.jadwal: Scheduled, Present, Late and Absent count up to today from the shift schedule (SPG → Schedule). A dash means no schedule was made for that SPG at that store, not zero.
keterangan.terlambat: Late: first check-in more than the shift start + {menit} minutes; minutes are counted from the shift start.
keterangan.izin: Leave: working days with approved leave, sick leave or annual leave on which the SPG did not come in.
keterangan.nilai: Receipts, pieces and value from that SPG's receipts at that store, net of goods shoppers returned.
keterangan.pengunjung: Visitors from the counter on the SPG phone. Days without a count use the day-closing figure, split evenly among the SPGs present — marked *.
keterangan.konversi: Conversion: receipts ÷ visitors, only on days with a visitor figure.
keterangan.target: Target reached: the SPG's net sales at all their stores ÷ their monthly target (Settings → Salesman → Target).
keterangan.tutup: Day closing: days with a day-closing report ÷ days the SPG sold.
keterangan.titip: Customer requests: created by the SPG this month, and how many are done.
keterangan.retur: Shopper returns: pieces returned by shoppers ÷ pieces on this month's receipts.

rincian.deskripsi: Day by day: schedule and check-in time, net sales, visitors, conversion, day closing and customer requests.
rincian.kosongIsi: This SPG holds no store and recorded no receipts, schedule or visitors in {bulan}.
rincian.catatanBintang: * Visitor figure from the day-closing report (the SPG did not use the counter that day), split evenly among the SPGs present.

pwaSpgPengunjung.penjelasan: Tap every time a visitor comes to the counter. The count is kept on the phone even without signal, and sent by itself when there is signal. The store total adds up every SPG of this store.

kantor.kosongSaldoIsi: Damaged goods land here when the warehouse counts a store return note carrying damaged or expired goods.
kantor.kosongRiwayatIsi: Incoming goods and warehouse decisions appear here.
kantor.hanyaLihat: Only users who can manage inventory can make decisions.
