kantor.deskripsi: Goods found short in a consignment stock count, transfers decided lost, deliveries received short, or recorded by the office. Finance decides who bears it — the store, an SPG, a salesperson or Elorae; a person's share is deducted from their commission or salary.
kantor.kosongIsi: Records open automatically from stock counts, transfers and delivery receipts, or are recorded manually with the button above.
kantor.kosongSaringIsi: Change the filters to see other records.
kantor.dibatasi: Showing the 300 most recent records — filter to see older ones.

manual.deskripsi: For missing goods not caught by a stock count, transfer or receipt — e.g. lost in a store's back room. The server values them using the basis in settings.
manual.cariBarang: Search name or SKU (at least 2 characters)
manual.catatanContoh: E.g. lost while moving racks, found missing during a back-room check.
manual.nilaiCatatan: Who bears it is decided after the record is created.
manual.kurangJumlah: Enter a quantity for every item (a whole number above zero).

rincian.menungguKelola: Decide who bears these goods, or cancel if they turn out not to be lost.
rincian.menungguLihat: Waiting for finance to decide who bears it.
rincian.adaTanpaNilai: Some lines have no value (unknown item or no price). Enter the total when deciding.
rincian.terkunci: A deduction or charge already exists for this record — the decision can no longer be changed or cancelled.
rincian.dasarTerimaIsi: The price at which this store last received the item; Elorae's selling price if it never has.
rincian.hargaCadangan: Elorae selling price — store never received it
rincian.keringanan: Employee discount relief {persen}%: {nilai} borne by Elorae.

caraLunas.TOKO_KONSI: Charged automatically when that month's consignment cycle is locked.
caraLunas.TOKO: Charge the store, then mark it as charged.
caraLunas.SPG: Deducted from the SPG's commission/salary when it is set, in instalments up to the percentage cap.
caraLunas.SALES: Mark as deducted in Reports → Salesperson commission.

keputusan.deskripsi: Split the total between the store, SPGs, salespeople or Elorae. Several bearers are allowed; the shares must add up to the total.
keputusan.totalIsi: Goods value by the valuation basis: {nilai}.
keputusan.totalBerubah: Total changed — a reason is required.
keputusan.bagianKosong: Pick one of the quick picks above, or add shares yourself.
keputusan.pas: The shares add up to the total.
keputusan.akibat: Elorae's share is written off immediately. A consignment store's share is charged in that month's cycle; SPG/sales shares are deducted from their commission/salary and the person is notified.
keputusan.kurangAlasanUbah: Enter the reason for the change.
keputusan.kurangAlasanTotal: The total was changed — enter the reason.
keputusan.ringanIsi: Fill in the shares as usual. Each SPG/sales share is reduced by this percentage (rounded down to whole rupiah) and Elorae bears the difference.
keputusan.kurangRinganOrang: Relief only applies to SPG/sales shares — add a person's share, or turn relief off.
keputusan.kurangRinganPersen: Enter a relief percentage from 1 to 100.

presetTidak.SALES_TOKO: This store has no holding salesperson.

kodeBagian.JUMLAH_TIDAK_SAH: Each share must be above zero, with at most two decimals.
kodeBagian.JUMLAH_TIDAK_SAMA: The shares do not add up to the total.

batal.deskripsi: Use this when the goods turn out not to be lost (e.g. sold without a receipt, found). The shares are removed and the people are notified. Not possible once a deduction or charge exists.
batal.contoh: E.g. turned out to be sold without a receipt.

tagih.judul: Mark the store's share as charged?
tagih.deskripsi: Outright stores are charged outside the system. Mark it once the charge has been sent to the store.

pengaturanBarangHilang.penjelasan: Missing goods are sometimes borne by the store, an SPG, a salesperson or Elorae — finance decides each case under SPG → Missing goods. This card sets how they are valued and how much may be deducted from one salary/commission payment.

dasarIsi.HARGA_ELORAE: The item's selling price in the master. The same for every store.
dasarIsi.HPP: The warehouse average cost — only Elorae's capital loss.
dasarIsi.ECERAN: The shelf price: selling price at outright stores, grossed up by the store margin at consignment stores.
dasarIsi.HARGA_TERIMA: The price at which that store last received the item. Outright store: the delivery note (net of line discounts). Consignment store: the in-store price less the store margin — 100,000 at a 25% margin becomes 75,000. Default.

pengaturanBarangHilang.dasarCatatan: The value is frozen when the record opens. The office may still change the total when deciding, with a reason.
pengaturanBarangHilang.persenIsi: At most {persen}% of one salary/commission payment is deducted for missing goods. The rest is carried into later payments, so one incident never wipes out a salary.
pengaturanBarangHilang.persenSalah: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
pengaturanBarangHilang.opnameLabel: Short consignment stock counts open a record
pengaturanBarangHilang.opnameIsi: Whenever an SPG counts fewer than the stock book at a consignment store, a missing-goods record opens for a decision. Outright stores do not — the goods belong to the store.
pengaturanBarangHilang.tanpaIzin: Only finance (receivables: manage) can change these rules.

pengaturanBarangHilang.dasarCadangan: If the store has never received the item, or the record has no store, Elorae's selling price is used.

bebanHilangSaya.semuaLunas: All your missing-goods charges are settled.
bebanHilangSaya.cara: Deducted from your commission/salary, at most {persen}% of one payment; the rest carries over.
bebanHilangSaya.dicicil: Being deducted in instalments from your commission/salary.
bebanHilangSaya.belumDipotong: Will be deducted from your next commission/salary.

komisiSalesmanHilang.deskripsi: Commission for {bulan}. Outstanding charge {sisa}; the cap is {persen}% of one commission payment. The amount goes to the oldest charges first.
komisiSalesmanHilang.saran: Suggested: {nilai} (percentage cap × this month's commission, less what was already deducted).
komisiSalesmanHilang.tanpaSaran: No suggestion — this month's commission is zero or the cap is used up. You can still enter an amount.
komisiSalesmanHilang.catatanKaki: Missing-goods charges are set by finance under SPG → Missing goods. The cap is {persen}% of one payment (Settings → SPG).

peranBawaan.PURCHASER: Purchasing staff — manages suppliers, POs and payments
peranBawaan.SPG: In-store promoter — phone app only, fixed to one store

dashboard_view.label: View home & operational reports
dashboard_view.keterangan: Opens the office home page (sales summary, to-do list, stock) and the operational reports.

reports_hpp_view.label: View cost of goods (HPP) report
reports_hpp_view.keterangan: Opens the production cost report per product, calculated from work orders.

sales_orders_view.label: View marketplace orders
sales_orders_view.keterangan: Opens Shopee, TikTok and Tokopedia orders received through Jubelio, their details and the fulfilment queue.

sales_orders_fulfill.label: Fulfil marketplace orders
sales_orders_fulfill.keterangan: Uses the pick, pack and ship buttons on marketplace orders; stock goes down when an order ships.

sales_returns_view.label: View marketplace returns
sales_returns_view.keterangan: Opens the list and details of items returned by marketplace buyers.

sales_returns_decide.label: Decide marketplace returns
sales_returns_decide.keterangan: Accepts or rejects each returned marketplace item.

field_sales_orders_view.label: View field orders & field team
field_sales_orders_view.keterangan: Opens putus and consignment orders from salespeople, pre-orders, and the Field Team pages (summary, schedule, attendance, leave, targets, announcements).

field_sales_orders_approve.label: Approve field orders
field_sales_orders_approve.keterangan: Approves or rejects salespeople's orders, sets appealed prices, releases pre-orders, approves goods exchanges and store transfers, changes Settings → Salesman and opens the salesman commission report.

field_sales_orders_deliver.label: Record putus deliveries
field_sales_orders_deliver.keterangan: Records partial or full deliveries, prints warehouse and billing notes, closes an order's remainder and records proof of delivery.

stores_view.label: View stores
stores_view.keterangan: Opens the store master, new-store proposals, store checklists, execution reports, display guides and competitor prices.

stores_manage.label: Manage stores
stores_manage.keterangan: Adds, edits and deactivates stores, moves stores to another salesperson, approves store-data changes from salespeople and processes SPG stock requests.

promos_view.label: View promotions
promos_view.keterangan: Opens putus-order promotions and SPG counter promotions.

promos_manage.label: Manage promotions
promos_manage.keterangan: Creates, edits and deactivates putus and counter promotions, and sets the SPG manual discount.

canvassing_manage.label: Manage van sales (canvassing)
canvassing_manage.keterangan: Loads van stock from the warehouse, reconciles what is left in the van at day end and opens the van sales register.

pwa_access.label: Use the phone app
pwa_access.keterangan: Opens the phone app for salespeople and SPGs: store visits, catalogue, orders, payments and store returns.

spg_sales_record.label: Sell at the store counter (SPG)
spg_sales_record.keterangan: Records sales, receives deliveries, counts shelves, handles shopper returns and transfers in the SPG phone app; its users must be given one fixed store.

spg_sales_view.label: Supervise SPGs
spg_sales_view.keterangan: Opens SPG sales, performance, day close, customers, schedules, commission, stock requests, store transfers, damaged and lost goods, and Settings → SPG.

receivables_view.label: View receivables
receivables_view.keterangan: Opens invoices & receivables, collection notes, payments & claims, store returns, shortfall charges, collection tasks and the return-note archive.

receivables_manage.label: Manage receivables
receivables_manage.keterangan: Imports invoices, creates collection notes, records receipts from the office, assigns collection tasks, decides who bears return shortfalls and lost goods, and manages deduction types.

consignment_view.label: View consignment
consignment_view.keterangan: Opens consignment cycles per store per month: consigned shipments, sales reports, bills and commission.

consignment_manage.label: Manage consignment
consignment_manage.keterangan: Records consigned shipments and sales reports, locks the figures, records note and tax-invoice numbers, and commission payments.

journals_view.label: View journals & ledger
journals_view.keterangan: Opens journals, the ledger per account, account mapping and cash-flow classification.

journals_manage.label: Manage journals & verify incoming money
journals_manage.keterangan: Creates manual journals, re-posts pending journals, matches receipts against bank statements, marks POs as paid and pays travel expenses.

coa_view.label: View chart of accounts
coa_view.keterangan: Opens the list of accounts used by journals.

finance_settlements_view.label: View marketplace settlements
finance_settlements_view.keterangan: Opens uploaded marketplace payout files and how they match orders.

finance_settlements_manage.label: Upload & match settlements
finance_settlements_manage.keterangan: Uploads Shopee/TikTok settlement files, matches their orders, re-syncs orders from Jubelio and posts their journals.

finance_reports_view.label: View financial reports
finance_reports_view.keterangan: Opens the trial balance, income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, including Excel and PDF export.

tax_invoices_view.label: View tax-invoice queue
tax_invoices_view.keterangan: Opens the list of billing notes waiting for a tax-invoice number.

tax_invoices_manage.label: Record tax-invoice numbers
tax_invoices_manage.keterangan: Records tax-invoice numbers, or marks a note as needing none with a reason.

purchase_orders_view.label: View purchase orders (PO)
purchase_orders_view.keterangan: Opens the list and details of POs, and the document archive.

purchase_orders_create.label: Create POs
purchase_orders_create.keterangan: Creates new purchase orders to suppliers.

purchase_orders_edit.label: Edit & cancel POs
purchase_orders_edit.keterangan: Changes a PO's content and cancels it.

purchase_orders_approve.label: Approve & send POs
purchase_orders_approve.keterangan: Approves a PO and sends it to the supplier, and closes a PO whose goods arrived short.

supplier_payments_view.label: View supplier payments
supplier_payments_view.keterangan: Opens what is owed to suppliers per PO and its payment status.

supplier_payments_create.label: Record supplier payments
supplier_payments_create.keterangan: Not used by any screen yet; marking a PO as paid uses the Manage journals & verify incoming money permission.

supplier_payments_edit.label: Edit supplier payments
supplier_payments_edit.keterangan: Not used by any screen yet; marking a PO as paid uses the Manage journals & verify incoming money permission.

vendor_returns_view.label: View returns to suppliers
vendor_returns_view.keterangan: Opens the list of goods returned to suppliers.

vendor_returns_create.label: Create returns to suppliers
vendor_returns_create.keterangan: Creates a return document for defective goods going back to a supplier.

vendor_returns_manage.label: Manage returns to suppliers
vendor_returns_manage.keterangan: Edits, processes, completes and deletes returns to suppliers.

suppliers_view.label: View suppliers
suppliers_view.keterangan: Opens the supplier master and supplier details.

suppliers_delete.label: Delete suppliers
suppliers_delete.keterangan: Deletes a supplier; requires your PIN.

supplier_types_view.label: View supplier types
supplier_types_view.keterangan: Opens the list of supplier types (fabric, accessories, tailors and others).

supplier_types_edit.label: Edit supplier types
supplier_types_edit.keterangan: Changes a supplier type's name and order.

supplier_types_delete.label: Delete supplier types
supplier_types_delete.keterangan: Deletes supplier types that are not in use.

lead_time_view.label: View lead time
lead_time_view.keterangan: Opens the process library and supplier chains with their durations.

lead_time_manage.label: Manage lead time
lead_time_manage.keterangan: Changes the process library and supplier chains.

inventory_view.label: View warehouse stock
inventory_view.keterangan: Opens inventory, the stock card, goods receipts (GRN) and the damaged-goods warehouse.

inventory_manage.label: Manage warehouse stock
inventory_manage.keterangan: Records goods receipts (GRN) and stock adjustments, decides damaged goods and completes goods exchanges.

inventory_opname_view.label: View stock counts
inventory_opname_view.keterangan: Opens the list and results of warehouse stock counts (opname).

inventory_opname_count.label: Count stock (opname & returns)
inventory_opname_count.keterangan: Creates and fills in stock counts, and counts goods returned from stores on the Count returns screen.

inventory_opname_approve.label: Approve stock counts
inventory_opname_approve.keterangan: Approves or cancels a count; its differences adjust stock.

inventory_reconciliation_view.label: View Jubelio reconciliation
inventory_reconciliation_view.keterangan: Opens the comparison of ERP stock with stock in Jubelio.

inventory_reconciliation_manage.label: Run Jubelio reconciliation
inventory_reconciliation_manage.keterangan: Runs the stock comparison and resolves its differences.

forecast_view.label: View forecast & S&OP
forecast_view.keterangan: Opens the demand forecast and sales reconciliation.

forecast_manage.label: Manage forecast
forecast_manage.keterangan: Imports sales data and runs the forecast calculation.

work_orders_view.label: View work orders
work_orders_view.keterangan: Opens the list and details of production work orders (WO).

work_orders_create.label: Create work orders
work_orders_create.keterangan: Creates new WOs, including from the work plan.

work_orders_manage.label: Run work orders
work_orders_manage.keterangan: Issues WOs, issues materials, receives finished goods and cancels WOs.

nota_register_view.label: View CMT note register
nota_register_view.keterangan: Opens the material-issue notes sent to tailors (CMT) and their prints.

production_colors_view.label: View colours & palettes
production_colors_view.keterangan: Opens the Pantone colour catalogue and the colour palette.

production_colors_manage.label: Save palettes & inks
production_colors_manage.keterangan: Saves colour palettes and the team's base print inks.

creative_view.label: View creative
creative_view.keterangan: Opens the KOL workspace: today's tasks, collaborations, KOLs, campaigns, samples, content, payments, calendar, reports and the content plan.

creative_manage.label: Manage creative
creative_manage.keterangan: Creates and changes collaborations, KOL data, campaigns, samples, content, KOL payments, agenda, the content plan and Creative settings.

items_view.label: View products
items_view.keterangan: Opens the product master, categories, size charts and barcode labels.

items_delete.label: Delete products
items_delete.keterangan: Deletes products and categories that are not in use.

items_manage.label: Manage photos, sizes & push to Jubelio
items_manage.keterangan: Uploads product photos, changes size charts and sends products to Jubelio.

settings_security_view.label: Open Settings
settings_security_view.keterangan: Opens the Settings page, account security and the Jubelio settings (categories, migration, couriers).

settings_security_manage.label: Manage users & security
settings_security_manage.keterangan: Adds users, changes roles and passwords, resets PINs, changes the company theme and runs Jubelio settings actions.

settings_rbac_view.label: View roles & permissions
settings_rbac_view.keterangan: Opens the list of roles and their permissions.

settings_rbac_manage.label: Create & edit roles
settings_rbac_manage.keterangan: Creates roles, changes their permissions and deletes roles nobody uses.

settings_documents_view.label: View document numbering
settings_documents_view.keterangan: Opens document number settings and the product code and barcode format.

settings_documents_manage.label: Change document numbering
settings_documents_manage.keterangan: Changes document number formats and the barcode format.

settings_tax_view.label: View VAT settings
settings_tax_view.keterangan: Opens the VAT (PPN) rate used by POs and notes.

settings_uom_view.label: View units
settings_uom_view.keterangan: Opens the list of product units and their conversions.

settings_uom_manage.label: Manage units
settings_uom_manage.keterangan: Adds and changes units and their conversions.

settings_pack_ratio_view.label: View pack ratio
settings_pack_ratio_view.keterangan: Opens the quantity per size in one pack for putus orders.

settings_pack_ratio_manage.label: Change pack ratio
settings_pack_ratio_manage.keterangan: Changes the quantity per size in one pack.

audit_trail_view.label: View audit trail
audit_trail_view.keterangan: Opens the record of who changed what and when.

jubelio_admin_view.label: Open the Jubelio API dashboard
jubelio_admin_view.keterangan: Opens the token status, API call log and Jubelio sync tools; best kept for admins.

err.AKUN_HUTANG_PAJAK: Tax payables are settled in Finance → Tax → Payments, not with a cash voucher.
err.JURNAL_DIBATALKAN: That journal line belongs to a cancelled voucher or payment (or its reversal), so it cannot be matched to a bank statement line.

financeBank.imporIsi: Statement for {akun}. Lines imported before are skipped; after importing, lines are auto-matched.
financeBank.formatDidukung: BCA, Mandiri, or any file with date, description, and debit/credit or amount columns.
financeBank.tanpaRekening: No cash or bank account yet
financeBank.tanpaRekeningIsi: Map the Bank/Cash roles in Account Mapping, or classify the account as Cash.
financeBank.kosongBelum: Every line is matched or ignored
financeBank.kosongIsi: Import a statement with the Import statement button.

aksi.lepasLewatVoucher: Recorded as a voucher — cancel the voucher to release it.

financeBank.manualIsi: Line of {tanggal} for {jumlah}. Pick a journal line on this account with the same amount.
financeBank.tanpaKandidat: No unmatched journal line with the same amount (±31 days). Record it with an account if it was never booked.
financeBank.catatIsiKeluar: Money out {jumlah}: recorded as an outgoing voucher with the account you choose, then matched.
financeBank.catatIsiMasuk: Money in {jumlah}: recorded as an incoming voucher with the account you choose, then matched.
financeBank.abaikanIsi: Ignored lines are left out of the reconciliation report (e.g. a duplicate line from the bank). Write the reason.
financeBank.hapusImporIsi: {baris} statement lines from this file are deleted too. An import with matched lines cannot be deleted.

laporan.tanpaMutasi: No statement imported for this account yet
laporan.cocok: Reconciled: the adjusted bank and book balances agree.
laporan.selisih: There is still a difference of {nilai}. Check the account's opening balance in the ledger and any statement not yet imported.
laporan.saldoBankTidakDiketahui: The bank balance is unknown — import a statement with a balance column or an opening balance summary.
laporan.sejak: Journals are compared from the first imported statement line ({tanggal}).
laporan.jurnalBelumCocok: Booked but not in the bank yet
laporan.mutasiBelumCocok: In the bank but not booked yet

formulirKol.pembuka: Hi {nama}! Fill in the details below so shipments from {brand} reach the right address in the right size.

contoh.catatanFit: e.g. likes loose fit, long sleeves

petunjuk.address: Street, house number, RT/RW, village, district.
petunjuk.rekening: Fill in if the collaboration is paid. This data is stored encrypted and only opened by our finance team for transfers and tax slips.
petunjuk.nik: 16 digits as on the ID card, for income-tax slips.
petunjuk.npwp: If you have an NPWP. Without one, the income-tax deduction is higher.

tersimpan.rekening: An account ending in {akhir} is already saved. Fill in again only to replace it.
tersimpan.nik: An NIK ending in {akhir} is already saved. Fill in again only to replace it.
tersimpan.npwp: An NPWP is already saved. Fill in again only to replace it.

formulirKol.setuju: I agree that {brand} may use this data for shipping goods and paying for the collaboration.
formulirKol.periksaLagi: Some fields need fixing — see the red text.

galat.REKENING_TIDAK_LENGKAP: Fill in bank name, account number and holder together.

gagal.TIDAK_BERLAKU: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new link via WhatsApp.
gagal.TERLALU_SERING: Sent too often. Wait a few minutes and try again.
gagal.KUNCI_TIDAK_ADA: Bank details cannot be accepted right now. Leave the bank section empty and send, or try again later.
gagal.GAGAL: Sending failed. Check your connection and try again.

terimaKasih.isi: We have received your details. The {brand} team will use them for the next shipment.
terimaKasih.tanpaUbahan: Your details already match what we have.
terimaKasih.ubahLagi: Something wrong? Open this link again and resend until {tanggal}.

mati.isi: This form link has been revoked or has expired. Ask our team for a new link via WhatsApp.

warnaPilihan.gagal: Colours could not be saved. Try again.
warnaPilihan.cariPantone: Search a Pantone name or code, e.g. Classic Blue / 19-4052
